errors.text_span: Alle Linien zeigen einen ähnlichen Trend, mit einem Rückgang des Wachstumspotenzials über die Jahre.
errors.evidence: This sentence makes a comparison between lines ("ähnlichen Trend") and provides a generalized summary, which violates the prompt's instruction to avoid comparisons and describe each line individually.

The description fails to mention any of the specific peaks or dips for any of the lines, such as the dip around 2009 and the peak around 2013-2015, which was an explicit requirement of the prompt ("vermerken Sie alle Spitzen, Rückgänge oder gleichbleibenden Trends").
